title: Putnami Workload Smoke Contract
description: The smoke contract the CLI derives from a workload's route inventory. It is data, never authored: every request names the route fact it came from, and the digest identifies the exact request list.

protocolVersion.description: Document version. A reader refuses any other value.

project.description: Canonical ID of the workload the contract belongs to.

derivedFrom.description: Documents the requests were derived from.

requests.description: Smoke requests in execution order. An empty list means nothing could be derived, which a verdict reports as unsupported.

digest.description: sha256: plus the hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of requests: members sorted by name, no insignificant whitespace, no HTML escaping.

source.description: One document a contract was derived from.

kind.description: Source document kind. Version 1 derives from the putnami.http-routes.v1 inventory only.

path.description: Workspace-relative, slash-separated path of the document read.

digest.description: Digest the source document declares for itself.

method.description: HTTP method. Version 1 derives read-only methods only.

path.description: Route path, relative to the target base URL.

maxStatus.description: Highest response status the request accepts; 499 for a derived request.

provenance.description: Source kind of the route fact the request was derived from, for example typed-api.
